# Dewangga Praxindo

> Web3 security researcher (Solidity + Rust + Sui Move) based in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. 3+ years auditing and building secure protocols. Competes in audit contests on Sherlock and Code4rena. $50M+ TVL deployed across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Solana, and Sui. Three full security audits, zero critical findings. Also ships AI agents and full-stack Next.js products.

Dewangga Praxindo (online: dewaxindo, Sherlock handle: BadGenius) audits the smart contracts that move real money, and builds them. Security work: competitive audit contests, pre-launch security reviews, threat models, fuzz and invariant testing. Build work: leverage vaults, liquidity-pool management, yield strategies, ZK privacy circuits (Noir), passkey wallet infrastructure, LLM agents, and the web apps around them (React, Next.js, TypeScript). Every change ships with fuzz tests, invariant tests, mutation testing, Slither and Aderyn before any audit.

## Expertise
- Security: smart contract auditing, competitive audit contests (Sherlock, Code4rena), threat modeling, fuzz/invariant/mutation testing (Foundry, Echidna), Slither, Aderyn; protocols audited with zero critical findings
- Languages: Solidity, Rust, Move (Sui), TypeScript
- Chains: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Solana, Sui, Polygon, XRP Ledger
- DeFi: leverage vaults, liquidity pools, yield optimization, cross-chain integrations; integrations with AAVE, Compound, Pendle, Uniswap V3/V4
- ZK & Privacy: zero-knowledge proofs with Noir; sealed predictions and time-locked reveals on Sui (Seal + Walrus)
- AI: LLM agents, RAG pipelines, evals, multi-agent resolution; MCP servers, x402 USDC payments
- Full-stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Postgres, PWA; passkey wallets (WebAuthn)
